senses.gloss: (b. h. כָּנַע)to press, oppress.—Part. pass. כְּנִיעַ, pl. כְּנִיעִין depressed, mournful.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 11:5:12">Y. Ter. XI, end, 48ᵇ</cite> <he>ע״י דאינון כ׳</he> because they are low-spirited.
